basic_details.job_title: DSWO Ri Bhoi Community Based Rehabilitation Worker Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: District Social Welfare Office Ri Bhoi (DSWO Ri Bhoi) has announced 1 vacancy for the Community Based Rehabilitation Worker (CBRW) post on a contract basis under the MEGHALAYA PROGRAMME FOR REHABILITATION OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES (MPRPD) Scheme. Eligible candidates must submit the offline application by hand to the Office of the District Social Welfare Officer, Ri Bhoi District, Nongpoh on or before 30 October 2026 during office hours. content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications in Standard Form should be submitted directly to the office of the District Social Welfare Officer, Ri Bhoi District, Nongpoh during office hours. Candidates must submit their applications in a self-stamped envelope clearly superscribed as “Application for the Post of Community Based Rehabilitation Worker (CBRW)”.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Cl. X (Passed) from a recognized board. 1 (One) year experience in the field of Disability. 18 to 32 years. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST candidates. The applicant should strictly be a domicile resident of the respective Byrnihat GS Circle, Umling C&RD Block (covering areas including 17th Mile (Pahamlang), 18th Mile (Umdoh), 20th Mile (Paham Mawlein), Amjok, Byrnihat, Kongripara, Narang, Umling, Umling Lambrang, Umsarang, Naingbarilum, Niangbarithem, Pahamsohbar, Pahamtyrlaw, Sohkhwai, Shakhoikuna, Sohkpu, Umjong, Umdu, Umdap Rangi, Umdap Dumu, Umsohma, Umladoh, Umden-la-ang, 15th Mile (Nongthymmai), Amphangiri, Ampher, Borbhuin, Dehal Bagan, Harlibagan, Lum Nongthymmai Byrnihat, Lumnongrim, Byrnihat proper, Nongkylla Khasi, Nongkylla Mikir, Ronghona, Rangsakona, Tamulkhushi, Upper Bagan, and Upper Amjok). content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of all testimonials and educational certificates. Voter Photo ID Card for address proof. Two recent passport-size photographs duly attested, attached to the Application Form. Self-stamped envelope superscribed with the post name.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted in the Standard Form. Incomplete applications or those received after the last date will not be accepted. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis under the MPRPD Scheme in Umling C&RD Block. Ensure all submitted photographs and testimonials are duly attested.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the post notified?
faq.answer: The notified post is Community Based Rehabilitation Worker (CBRW).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the CBRW post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the application is 30 October 2026 during office hours.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Class X (Cl. X Passed) along with 1 year of experience in the field of disability.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 32 years, with a 5-year age relaxation for SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly remuneration for this post?
Q7. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is purely on a contractual basis under the MEGHALAYA PROGRAMME FOR REHABILITATION OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES (MPRPD) Scheme.

faq.question: Q8. Who is eligible to apply based on residence?
faq.answer: Applicants must strictly be domicile residents of the respective Byrnihat GS Circle, Umling C&RD Block.

faq.question: Q9. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: The application in Standard Form along with attested testimonials, Voter ID, photographs, and a self-stamped envelope must be submitted offline to the office of the District Social Welfare Officer, Ri Bhoi District, Nongpoh.
